notes.title: Car Mechanic Simulator VR demo is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Dear Car Mechanic Simulator VR Fans!

Shortly: [b]DEMO IS OUT NOW ON STEAM![/b]
To play, simply enter the CMS VR game page on Steam and click the "PLAY DEMO" button, here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1088770/Car_Mechanic_Simulator_VR/
[b]What you can find in the demo?[/b]
- 2 cars
- tutorial
- chill room
- hidden mascot <3
- engine elevator / crane
- weld mask, helmet, goggles
- wrench, screwdriver, screw gun, welder
- and more!

[b]Keep in mind that recording, streaming, capturing and sharing gameplays and let's plays are allowed![/b]

[b]Supported VR goggles/headsets:[/b]
- HTC Cosmos
- HTC Cosmos Elite
- HTC Vive
- HTC Vive Pro
- Microsoft Mixed Reality (various VR headsets, not AR)
- Oculus Quest (link only)
- Oculus Quest 2 (link only)
- Oculus Rift
- Oculus Rift S
- Steam VR (various VR headsets)
- Valve Index

[b]Available languages:[/b]
- Chinese
- Czech
- Dutch
- English
- Estonian
- Finnish
- French
- German
- Greek
- Hungarian
- Italian
- Japanese
- Korean
- Polish
- Portuguese
- Portuguese (Brazilian)
- Russian
- Spanish
- Turkish

[b]Changelog:[/b]
- Engine stand (physical rotation of the engine) - after pulling the lock the engine can be rotated manually while hanging on the stand.
- When all parts of the car/engine are disassembled, it automatically switches to assembly mode.
- Save the demo information reviewed by the player (tablet) so that it does not reappear when returning from the Showroom.
- Modified repositioning of objects within the car when switching body visibility.
- Improved feeling of grabbing and operating screwdrivers.
- Added scrolling of lists of items to assemble.
- Infinite scrolling of the shop eliminated.
- On engine status it is now possible to unscrew the engine with tools.
- Improvements to hands and 360 degree rotation during game play.
- General bugs fixes and improvements.

And once again, dear players, we would like to ask you for feedback from the game. Please, complete the below survey after you play the game. You can also report bugs if you encounter any.
[b]General demo build survey:[/b]
https://forms.gle/KnTm5AdrTw773uKPA
[b]Demo bug report form:[/b]
https://forms.gle/vai99s44KfVXp12E8

We would love to thank all beta testers for your feedback. And we want to hear your voice once again because we care what you think about our game! <3

[b]Watch the new gameplay trailer:[/b]
[previewyoutube=pmuJsxPSSX0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Long-awaited patch 1.5.22 is here! It was our longest beta so far, but we wanted this patch to be tested and packed with a lot of great content.[/b]
Check out new chrome paint for rims and body panels, engine swaps, new 60+ performance parts for free Tuning DLC, Korean language, more optimizations - you can enable low quality car shadows in options now - it will boost your game performance a lot with cost of little less detailed car shadows. There is more - go and explore :)

- RIMS PAINTING
- added CHROME paint type to rims
- added CHROME paint type to cars/body parts
- Added over 60 new performance parts
- Added LOW QUALITY CAR SHADOWS into settings
- added KOREAN language
- engines have now unique names to help them identify
- UI improvements
- performance optimizations
- Fixed bug when after creating new profile some cars from different profile was deleted
- Engine swaps blocked in missions and customers cars
- updated Turkish language

[h1]Hello CMS18 community![/h1]
We are proud to present you TUNING DLC, which will unlock few new cool features of Car Mechanic Simulator 2018!

[i]you can now install custom bumpers, light, hood, fenders etc[/i]

[b]Mechanical Tuning Shop[/b]
[i]install performance parts into your engine and give your engine better engine performance[/i]

[b]Dyno in which you can check your car current power[/b]
[i]Engine power condition is calculated from its condition, tuning parts and quality parts[/i]

[b]And all this for free - like we did promised you![/b]

[i]Keep in mind that Tuning DLC will be updated with game. We are planning to add more mechanical parts and also body parts into it. [/i]

With 1.4.5 we also introduced cases so make sure to complete some orders to get them!

[img]http://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/710430/ss_b6fb336c0c6846303e220956a6d2d2b320683ede.600x338.jpg?t=1509460284[/img]

[h1]What is what[/h1]
Body Tuning : replace bumpers, mirrors, fenders etc
Mechanical Tuning : replace mechanical parts on those which add more Torque to engine
Dyno : check what is exact power and torque of your car (those data are calculated from engine condition, tuning parts and quality items (new to cms))

[h1]Cases[/h1]
Cases could be received for completing orders. You have 40% chance to receive case after finishing completed order.
Case will contain 3 quality parts which can be installed into your car. 

[h1]Quality Parts[/h1]
Quality part will raise car value and if its tuning part, add more Torque to the engine.
So you can make your car special by installing a lot of quality parts in it.

[img]http://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/710430/ss_fe5fa36daede0a47e716b72f191c97cc09f8f0cd.600x338.jpg?t=1509460284[/img]

Next goal : Steam Workshop and adding more items into Tuning DLC

notes.title: RACE TRACK, CAR SALON Patch 1.1.9
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29076066/54994064961d5d5f2b570d0040fad71e33d3e4b3.jpg[/img]

[b]We are pleased to introduce you patch 1.1.9 in which we added Race Track and Car Salon into game! [/b]

Please take your time to read those few words from developer.

Since game release day, 2 weeks ago, we were patching fixing and changing game constantly. There were 19 patches so far. We are working around the clock, 7 days a week to make this game work better and to make it bug free.

Part of a core team need a short break soon - few days should do the job - they do not saw their families much lately, and most of the team look like zombies now :) We decided that some of us will stay here and work on fixes, but next patch will need all team presence, so please keep that in mind, and give us few days to repair our health.

What next? In next weeks we would like to add few bigger things :
- Achievements, that you are waiting for
- Expandable Parkings, so you can store more cars inside
- Dyno, so you can measure your engine real horsepower
- New bonus track, to go crazy drift
- New Modding features
Besides this we will be patching and adding smaller features as always.
We are also remember about tuning parts and body tuning parts which we promised to deliver.

Also we would like to thank all for showing us support and raising our spirit. Thank you for reporting bugs, sending us logs, saves or screenshots so we can find those nasty bugs. Its because of you this game gets better and better every day.

[b]Remember that if you like what we do, and you care about this series future, leave review on Steam. It is very important for us as a developer.
Each positive review gives us big boost to work, and after 14 hours of work each day, this positive feedback is telling us that someone is appreciating this.[/b]

Thank you!
